comments.body:
This is a good start, but these other projects should also be included, no?

  • fcrepo-camel-toolbox
  • fcrepo-camel
  • fcrepo-message-consumer
  • fcrepo4/fcrepo-boms/fcrepo4-bom
  • fcrepo4-oaiprovider
  • migration-utils
  • fcrepo4-client

Additional PRs here:

fcrepo4-client: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-client/pull/30
fcrepo-message-consumer: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-message-consumer/pull/96
migration-utils: https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/migration-utils/pull/37
fcrepo4-oaiprovider: https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/pull/23

The following PRs have been merged:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/909
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-oaiprovider/pull/23
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/migration-utils/pull/37
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-message-consumer/pull/96
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo4-client/pull/30

The following PRs have pending code review comments:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-camel-toolbox/pull/53
https://github.com/fcrepo4-exts/fcrepo-camel/pull/93
I left comments in the two PRs. In short, I think the PRs are good as they stand.

Just as a note: this now allows me to use fcrepo-parent in the build machinery for https://github.com/acoburn/repository-extension-services: http://git.io/vcGd3

And once the next fcrepo4 release is public, I won't need to pull from the snapshot repo.
